release.name: v3.0.0
release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: comprehensively rewrite and humanize all documentation by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/1
* 🧪 Add test for return_to_launcher return value by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/9
* 🧪 Add test for load_css_from_file path traversal check by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/12
* 🧹 Refactor game header creation to use shared ui_utils helper by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/14
* 🧹 Remove unused stub function return_to_launcher by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/15
* ⚡ Cache data directory path resolution in get_data_dir by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/16
* 🔒 Replace rand() with GLib RNG for secrets by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/17
* 🧹 [Refactor tic tac toe UI setup to improve readability] by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/18
* ⚡ Cache top scores to optimize launcher load time by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/19
* 🧪 [Add valid CSS loading tests for persistence] by @EL-STRIX in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/21

## New Contributors
* @EL-STRIX made their first contribution in https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EL-STRIX/C-GAMES-COLLECTION/compare/v2.0.1...v3.0.0
